title: enrichment-timeout-incident
blurb: Optional search enrichment stalls for minutes, consumes worker capacity, and turns a dependency slowdown into an outage.
brief:
Search enrichment began stalling after a downstream deploy. The incident evidence shows successful requests taking minutes until every worker slot was occupied and health checks failed.

Start with `logs/incident.log` and `diagnostics/capacity.txt`, then inspect `search/service.py`. Time and the downstream client are deterministic.

**Your job:** enforce the 750 ms enrichment budget, return useful base results on timeout, and preserve genuine overload behavior.
